name: toolcrib
description: Per-category slice of component-manifest.json's "components" array (category: Layout Primitives), for on-demand detail without loading the full manifest. See component-manifest.json for themeSystem/zIndexScale/eventBus and cross-category data.

components.name: AccessibleIcon

label.description: Accessible name announced to screen readers, the way `alt` works for ``.

components.description: Adds a screen-reader-only accessible name to a decorative icon element

components.name: AspectRatio
components.description: Constrains content to a fixed width-to-height ratio

components.name: Block

padding.description: Padding, using the same global padding token scale (`--ai-padding-*`) every other component's own padding resolves through.

paddingMode.description: Per-instance override for which padding density scale `padding` resolves against (compact/normal/spacious) — same `PaddingMode` every other component's own `paddingMode` prop uses.

radius.description: Corner radius, using the same global radius token scale (`--ai-radius-*`) every other component's own radius resolves through.

cornerRadiusMode.description: Per-instance override for which radius scale `radius` resolves against (sharp/subtle/rounded/pill) — same `CornerRadiusMode` every other component's own `cornerRadiusMode` prop uses.

subtheme.description: Apply a subtheme colour to background/border/text. Falls back to the nearest `<StyleDomainProvider>`'s if omitted. Wins over `background` when resolved; only colors the border if `border` is also set.

appearance.description: Visual treatment for `subtheme`'s color. Ignored unless a subtheme resolves.

components.constraints: Not a layout tool: use VStack/HStack/Grid for direction, alignment and gaps. Stay in theme first (props, overrides, StyleDomainProvider, theme-level changes); a raw styled div/span is the last resort, and its style still uses var(--ai-*) theme variables, never literal hex/px
components.description: Themed surface `<div>`: background, padding, radius, border and subtheme colouring, all from theme tokens — no style/className, like every toolcrib component

components.name: Content

gap.description: Gap between children. Named tokens map to theme spacing scale.

marginMode.description: Override margin/gap using the theme margin token scale.

squareCorners.description:
Explicit corner-squaring override. `<Content>` always establishes a
layout domain (equivalent to `<Card layout="auto">`), so it already
consults the nearest ancestor `<Splitter>`'s layout domain via
`useCornerSquaring` automatically — set this only to override that
with a specific edge instead of deferring to the domain.

components.description: Fills its container and establishes a flex-column layout domain for its children

columns.description:
Number of columns, or `'auto-fit'` / `'auto-fill'` for responsive behaviour.
When using auto modes, `minColWidth` controls the minimum column width.

minColWidth.description: Minimum column width for auto-fit/auto-fill modes.

marginMode.description: Override margin/gap using the theme margin token scale.

paddingMode.description: Override padding using the theme padding token scale.

gap.description:
Gap between children. Named tokens map to theme spacing scale.
`'gap'` uses the global `--ai-margin-gap` variable.

paddingMode.description: Override padding using the theme padding token scale.

marginMode.description: Override margin using the theme margin token scale (affects gap sizing).

cornerRadiusMode.description: Override corner radius using the theme radius token scale.

wrap.description: Allow children to wrap onto multiple lines instead of overflowing/shrinking.

components.name: Separator

orientation.description:
Layout axis. `'horizontal'` divides stacked content; `'vertical'`
divides side-by-side content (needs a sizing/flex ancestor to be
visible, same as any 100%-height element).

decorative.description:
Purely presentational (true) vs. a semantic content boundary announced
to assistive tech (false).

components.description: Themed visual divider between content sections

components.name: Text

as.description: Element to render: `'p'` for a paragraph, `'span'` for inline text.

size.description: Step on the theme's text size ramp (`--ai-text-size-*`). Inherits the surrounding size when omitted.

tone.description: `'default'` is the theme's main text color; `'secondary'` its muted one. Inherits the surrounding color when omitted, so text inside a filled Button or an Alert keeps their color.

weight.description: Font weight token. Inherits when omitted.

mono.description: Monospace family, for codes and identifiers.

subtheme.description: Status color for the text. Falls back to the nearest `<StyleDomainProvider>`'s. Wins over `tone` and `variant`.

variant.description: Identity color (`primary`/`secondary`) for the text. Ignored if a subtheme resolves; wins over `tone`.

overrides.description: Per-instance override for the size ramp (`scale`).

components.constraints: `as` is `'p'` or `'span'` only. Sets no margin; space paragraphs with `<VStack gap>`. Headings, labels and links have their own components
components.antiPatternAvoid:
A raw `

` or a styled `` for secondary text
components.description: Themed paragraph or inline text: size, tone, weight and status color from theme tokens, never literal styles

components.name: Toolbar

variant.description:
Visual style variant.
- `'primary'` — Filled with primary colour.
- `'secondary'` — Filled with secondary colour.
- `'outline'` — Transparent with border.
- `'danger'` — Filled with error colour.
- `'ghost'` — No background or border.

size.description: Button size controlling padding and font-size.

paddingMode.description: Override padding using the theme padding token scale.

cornerRadiusMode.description: Override corner radius using the theme radius token scale.

leadingIcon.description: Icon rendered before the label text. Alias for `icon`.

trailingIcon.description: Icon rendered after the label text.

subtheme.description: Apply a subtheme colour. Falls back to the nearest `<StyleDomainProvider>`'s if omitted.

squareCorners.description:
Explicit corner-squaring override, e.g. for a trigger button whose
corner needs to flatten against an open `<Popup>`/`<DropdownMenu>`.
Applied after the button's own computed radius, so it wins.

overrides.description:
Per-instance overrides for label weight and icon spacing. Separate from
`subtheme` above (Button already resolves that itself via
`useResolvedSubtheme`, unrelated to this slice's own two fields).

slotDescriptions.Button: Supports five variants, three sizes, subtheme colouring, and icon slots.

paddingMode.description: Override padding using the theme padding token scale.

marginMode.description: Override margin using the theme margin token scale (unused, reserved).

cornerRadiusMode.description: Override corner radius using the theme radius token scale.

orientation.description:
Arrow-key axis for the roving-tabindex group the toolbar root
establishes. Only affects children rendered via `<Toolbar.Button>` —
arbitrary children (a plain `<Button>`, a `<Select>`, a `<Tooltip>`
trigger) never joined the group in the first place, so they keep normal
tab order regardless of this setting.

overrides.description: Per-instance override for the gap within each slot (`Toolbar.Left`/`.Center`/`.Right`).

components.description: Horizontal action bar with left/center/right slot areas

components.name: UIGroup

orientation.description:
Group layout direction.
- `'horizontal'` — Children laid out in a row (default).
- `'vertical'` — Children stacked vertically.

borderRadius.description: Override border radius for the outer corners.

components.description: Merges adjacent elements into a single visual compound control

components.name: VisuallyHidden
components.description: Hides content visually while keeping it announced to screen readers

gap.description:
Gap between children. Named tokens map to theme spacing scale.
`'gap'` uses the global `--ai-margin-gap` variable.
